blockers.description: CR-01: every publish to a PRIVATE channel declares waitForAuth:[wrap.pubkey] that the community's StreamSigners can never answer. deriveConcordKeys populates keys.channels for private channels too (only keyless ones skipped); planeKeyFor resolves the private channel's message-plane key from that map; but the community holder is registered with core planes + publicChannelKeys(), which filters !c.private. On an auth-gating relay the publish waits out the 30s authTimeout, publishToPlane's .catch swallows it, and the optimistic echo shows the message as sent.
blockers.workaround: None applied. Independently confirmed structurally by the orchestrator (keys.ts:181-189 has no private filter; community.ts:719-724 filters !c.private; community.ts:753-759 registers the holder). Fix likely belongs in streamPublishOptions or in what the community holder registers.

opencode leaks a 13.7MB miniaudio .so per launch; the tmpfs quota was exhausted and every Bash command producing stdout failed. User approved. The 3 live-mapped copies were preserved.

decisions.decision: Reordered the relay auth debug namespace to applesauce:Relay:auth:<url>
decisions.rationale: User request — auth at fixed depth so applesauce:Relay:auth:* filters all relays. Cost: the per-relay glob no longer sweeps auth lines; D-13 re-derived into two tests asserting both halves.

decisions.decision: resetState stays silent when 0 authenticated pubkeys were dropped
decisions.rationale: User request — a held challenge with nothing authenticated has no re-auth cycle to explain. WR-02 test inverted to assert the silence; the miscount it guards still breaks it.
